item.title: Ep 4: About 100,000 households around Kyiv lost internet after Russian strikes that killed four.
item.description: Omni View Europe About 100,000 households around Kyiv lost internet after Russian strikes that killed four. What You Need to Know: About 100,000 households in Kyiv and the surrounding region lost internet after Russian strikes on data centres and telecommunications sites, and Ukrainian officials said a drone strike on a business centre killed four people. The European Commission has proposed energy and water labels for large data centres, without setting consumption caps. ... item.title: Ep 3: A one hundred twenty million euro fine on X now has Washington asking to join the case.
item.description: Omni View Europe A one hundred twenty million euro fine on X now has Washington asking to join the case. What You Need to Know: Washington has asked to join the court fight over the European Union’s one hundred twenty million euro fine on X, imposed on the platform and Elon Musk in December 2025. The US filing does not cancel the fine; the EU’s General Court still has to decide whether Washington may take part. ... item.title: Ep 1: Italy’s Senate approved a plan to restart nuclear power nearly 40 years after a referendum…
item.description: Omni View Europe Italy’s Senate approved a plan to restart nuclear power nearly 40 years after a referendum closed the reactors. What You Need to Know: Italy’s upper house gave final approval to legislation that sets a 12-month deadline for decrees to relaunch nuclear generation and creates an independent regulator. Germany published a roadmap that for the first time makes an explicit commitment to phase out fossil fuels by 2045 while raising renewable electricity targets. ...
